content:
Hello! I’ve released a public beta of my MSc dissertation project: an interactive proof-tree visualizer for Lean 4 that renders tactics proofs as trees in the VS Code infoview and lets you edit the proof directly from the tree. It depends on Paperproof’s parser for proof extraction, but the UI is completely new (picture attached). It currently works with Lean/Mathlib v4.32.2:

https://github.com/aidanmaney/ramify-lean4

If you do try it there’s a short (15 min) questionnaire that follows the project tutorial (30 min). Responses in the next week will be used to inform my dissertation and all responses will inform further development afterwards:

https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/pSn0sgxf7T
